title: Market Power and Distributed Solar Integration in Microgrids under Limited Regulation
abstract: arXiv:2603.16893v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Decentralized electricity systems increasingly emerge where centralized grids fail to provide reliable supply. In such settings, privately operated neighborhood microgrids, often based on diesel generators, exhibit significant market power, limited regulatory oversight, and high environmental externalities. In parallel, households increasingly deploy off-grid solar photovoltaic (PV) systems to gain control over electricity supply. However, these systems suffer from curtailed excess generation during peak solar hours and unreliable access at other times. translated_title: 有限监管下微电网中的市场力量与分布式太阳能整合
translated_abstract: 在集中式电网无法提供可靠供电的地区，分散式电力系统日益涌现。在此类环境中，由私人运营的社区微电网（通常基于柴油发电机）表现出显著的市场力量、有限的监管监督和高环境外部性。与此同时，家庭越来越多地部署离网太阳能光伏（PV）系统，以获取对电力供应的控制权。然而，这些系统在太阳能高峰时段面临多余发电被削减的问题，并在其他时段面临供电不可靠的挑战。尽管以往研究从技术经济角度优化了低可靠性电网环境下的微电网，但它们在很大程度上忽视了垄断性私人发电商所行使的市场力量。本文通过开发一个双层博弈论模型来填补这一空白，该模型允许家庭发电馈入微电网，同时明确考虑了市场力量的影响。
tldr: 本文提出一个双层博弈论模型，在有限监管下整合家庭太阳能发电进入微电网，并首次明确考虑垄断私人发电商的市场力量，以优化分布式太阳能利用和缓解市场扭曲。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a bi-level game-theoretic model that integrates household solar generation into microgrids under limited regulation, explicitly accounting for monopolistic generator market power to optimize distributed solar utilization and mitigate market distortions.
